collection.description: A deaf teen loves the festival but cannot follow the drummer's shouted cues.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A deaf teen loves the festival but cannot follow the drummer's shouted cues. Their friends assume they would rather sit out.

choices.label: Invite them to lead the design

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The teen suggests visible signals and feels included without being singled out.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Dancers use vibrations and hand cues; a new festival tradition begins.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They create a visual sequence everyone enjoys, though some rehearsals go hilariously wrong.
